Models:
- Llama 3.2 1B Instruct (2024-09-18, llama3.2): 1B dense instruct model. The architecture numbers are the GGUF header, because Meta's config.json is access-gated.
- Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (2024-09-18, llama3.2): 3B dense instruct model. Architecture from the public GGUF header.
- Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (2024-07-18, llama3.1): 8B dense instruct model and the usual baseline for a gaming PC.
- Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (2024-11-26, llama3.3): 70B dense instruct model. Only the single-file Q4_K_M size is listed; larger quants were split archives.
- Qwen2.5 7B Instruct (2024-09-16, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
- Qwen2.5 14B Instruct (2024-09-16, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
- Qwen2.5 32B Instruct (2024-09-17, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
- Qwen2.5 72B Instruct (2024-09-16, other): Dense 72B instruct model. The Hugging Face license field is other. Only the single-file Q4_K_M size is listed.
- Qwen3 8B (2025-04-27, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
- Qwen3 14B (2025-04-27, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
- Qwen3 32B (2025-04-27, apache-2.0): Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
- Qwen3 30B-A3B (2025-04-27, apache-2.0): Mixture-of-experts Qwen3. All 48 layers are sparse (decoder_sparse_step 1) with 8 of 128 experts active.
- Qwen3.5 9B (2026-02-27, apache-2.0): Hybrid model: 24 linear-attention layers and 8 full-attention layers. The GGUF used here is the language-model file.
- Qwen3.8 27B (2026-08-05, apache-2.0): Hybrid 27B model: 48 linear-attention layers and 16 full-attention layers. Recommended file is Unsloth UD-Q4_K_M.
- Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (2026-04-15, apache-2.0): Hybrid MoE: 256 experts, 8 active, plus a shared expert. 30 layers are linear attention and 10 are full attention.
- Gemma 3 4B Instruct (2025-02-20, gemma): Sliding-window model. Config sliding_window_pattern is 6, so every 6th layer is full attention and the rest keep a 1,024-token window.
- Gemma 3 12B Instruct (2025-03-01, gemma): Sliding-window model. Config sliding_window_pattern is 6, so every 6th layer is full attention and the rest keep a 1,024-token window.
- Gemma 3 27B Instruct (2025-03-01, gemma): Sliding-window model. Config sliding_window_pattern is 6, so every 6th layer is full attention and the rest keep a 1,024-token window.
- Gemma 4 E2B (2026-03-02, apache-2.0): Small Gemma 4 model. 28 sliding layers (window 512) and 7 full layers. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
- Gemma 4 E4B (2026-03-02, apache-2.0): Gemma 4 model sized for laptops and handhelds. 35 sliding layers (window 512) and 7 full layers. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
- Gemma 4 12B (2026-05-23, apache-2.0): Dense Gemma 4 12B. 40 sliding layers (window 1,024) and 8 full layers with global_head_dim 512 and 1 global KV head. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
- Gemma 4 26B-A4B (2026-03-11, apache-2.0): MoE Gemma 4. config top_k_experts is 8 of num_experts 128, moe_intermediate_size 704. 25 sliding layers and 5 full layers.
- Gemma 4 31B (2026-03-11, apache-2.0): Dense Gemma 4 31B. 50 sliding layers (window 1,024) and 10 full layers.
- gpt-oss-20b (2025-08-04, apache-2.0): Open-weight reasoning MoE. The published GGUF is MXFP4, not Q4_K_M. 4 of 32 experts run each token. Half the layers use a 128-token sliding window.
- gpt-oss-120b (2025-08-04, apache-2.0): Larger gpt-oss MoE. MXFP4 file. 4 of 128 experts run each token.
- Phi-4 (2024-12-11, mit): Dense 14B-class Phi-4. head_dim is hidden_size / num_attention_heads from config.json (5120 / 40).
- Phi-4-mini Instruct (2025-02-19, mit): Small Phi-4. The config sliding_window is 262,144, larger than the 131,072 context, so the KV estimate treats every layer as full attention.
- Mistral Nemo 12B Instruct (2024-07-17, apache-2.0): Dense 12B Mistral. Context used here is config max_position_embeddings, 131,072.
- Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct (2025-06-19, apache-2.0): Dense 24B Mistral Small 3.2 (2506). Ollama's mistral-small:24b tag is labeled 2501, so this page does not show an Ollama command.
- Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct (2025-11-28, apache-2.0): Mistral's 24B coding model (2512), 40 dense layers, context 393,216. Ollama's devstral:24b tag is the earlier 2505 build, so no command is shown.
- DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 14B (2025-01-20, mit): Reasoning distill on the Qwen2.5 14B architecture. use_sliding_window is false.
- DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B (2025-01-20, mit): Reasoning distill on the Qwen2.5 32B architecture.
- SmolLM3 3B (2025-07-08, apache-2.0): Dense 3B model from Hugging Face. All 36 layers are full attention. No Ollama library tag was found for SmolLM3.
